name: Atoll
readme_excerpt: Atoll - DynamicIsland for macOS Join our Discord community Atoll turns the MacBook notch into a focused command surface for media, system insight, and quick utilities. It stays out of the way until needed, then expands with responsive, native SwiftUI animations. Highlights - Media controls for Apple Music, Spotify, Cider, and more with inline previews. - Live Activities for media playback, Focus, screen recording, privacy indicators, downloads (beta), and battery/charging. - Lock screen widgets…
